Renderings: the other Akkadian flood versions (project glossary)

The shared ../renderings.md binds; this file extends it with words that occur in these texts and not (or not in this sense) in the shared file. Words already fixed by Gilg. XI (../2-גילגמש-XI--סיפור-המבול/renderings.md) or by Atra-ḫasīs (../1-אתרחסיס/renderings.md) are followed and listed here only when the choice matters for these texts.
Format (guidelines §6.6): Akkadian | Hebrew | rejected | reason / tag | lines.

1. Formulas

Akkadian Hebrew Rejected Reason Lines
igār igār kikkiš kikkiš קִיר, קִיר! גְּדֵר־קָנֶה, גְּדֵר־קָנֶה! The shared formula in the Ark's order (Gilg. XI 21 has the reverse order). Ark 1
X pâšu īpuš-ma iqabbi / izakkar ana Y (SB, two lines) X פָּתַח אֶת פִּיו וְאָמַר, / דִּבֵּר אֶל Y: Gilg. XI 36–37 (proposed for the shared file). W 11′–12′, U 13–14, BM 38917 obv. 10′–11′
OB X pīašu īpušam-ma / izzakkar(am-ma) ana Y X פָּתַח אֶת פִּיו / וְדִבֵּר אֶל Y: Shared OB formula. C₀ iv 11′–12′
MB pîšu ippušam-ma [iqabbi] (present) פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת פִּיו [וְאוֹמֵר] פתח The Akkadian has the present; the Hebrew keeps the difference. J₁ 4′, 8′
ezub N kur upazzirū ummiānū מִלְּבַד N כּוֹר שֶׁהִצְפִּינוּ הָאֻמָּנִים ↔ Gilg. XI 69–70 מלבד … הצפין המלח. Identical in Ark 33 and 58. Ark 33, 58
ākilum ikkal šātûm išatti Atr. III's Hebrew (C₁ ii 43″–44″) Shared line. Ark 38
kūm taškunu abūba בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר חוֹלַלְתָּ מַבּוּל תחת אשר (= Gilg. XI ammaku) kūm "instead of" is another word than ammaku; the Hebrew differs exactly there. z v 4′–8′
(ana) šār erbetti (לְ)אַרְבַּע הָרוּחוֹת As Gilg. XI 157. U r. 5′

2. Words

Akkadian Hebrew Rejected Reason / tag Lines
qâlu "pay attention (in silence)" הֶאֱזִין הקשיב (= ḫasāsu, šitammû), שׂם לב (= naʾādu, Gilg. XI 34) One Hebrew verb per Akkadian verb. Ark 2, I 15, I₂ 7
milku עֵצָה As Gilg. XI 198. Ark 2, I 1, I 9, I 15, U r. 17′
dāriš, ana dāriš; dārû לָעַד; קַיָּם לעולם (would pre-empt וָחַי לְעֹלָם, ג:כב) dārû is from the root of דּוֹר [cognate, different meaning]: noted. Ark 3, z v 14′
napādu (upud) / abātu (ubut) as Atr. III (shared OB הֲרֹס) The Ark has the OB verb (C₂ i 22′). Wasserman: upud "depart"; eBL: ubut "destroy". Ark 4
šullumu (napištam šullim) שְׁמֹר (נֶפֶשׁ) שְׁלֵמָה החיה (= bulluṭu) D of šalāmu "keep whole": the root שלם surfaces in the adjective. Ark 5
epēšu (the boat) עָשָׂה בנה (= banû) ↔ וְזֶה אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ (ו:טו) [equivalent]. Ark 6, J r. 10′, W 13′, I₂ 5, 10
eṣēru, eṣertu / uṣurtu צָר, צוּרָה שִׂרְטֵט (Gilg. XI 60) Atr. I's choice: eṣēru is cognate of יצר; the root צור "draw a form" keeps the sense (צוּרַת הַבַּיִת, יחזקאל מג:יא). Ark 6–7, W 14′–16′, BM 38917 obv. 5′, 7′
kippatu עִגּוּל שטח (Gilg. XI 58, George) The Ark's shape word. Ark 7, W 2′
šiddu / pūtu צַד / מֵצַח אורך / רוחב (= mūraku / rupšu) Literal: "side" and "brow" (the long and the short side in metrology). mūraku occurs in Ark 14, 16 (אֹרֶךְ), so the words must differ. pūtu = מצח also in z v 20′–21′. Ark 8, z v 20′–21′
qaqqaru קַרְקַע As Gilg. XI 41. Ark 9, W 14′, 16′
ikû / nindanu / ašlu / parsiktu / kurru / qû אִיקוּ / קָנֶה / אַשְׁלוּ / פַּרְסִיכְתּוּ / כּוֹר / קוּ kurru = כֹּר [cognate]. Values in notes: ikû c. 3,600 m²; nindanu c. 6 m; ašlu = 10 nindanu, c. 60 m; kurru = 300 qû; qû c. 1 l. Ark 9–16, 33, 58
kannu רְצוּעָה "Band, tape". Ark 10
ṭawû שָׁזַר Ark 10
patālu / pitiltu פָּתַל / פְּתִיל [cognate] both (Gilg. XI 54 פְּתִיל). Ark 11
ṣēlu (ṣēru) "rib" צֵלָע [cognate]; Hebrew צֵלָע is also a building beam (שמות כו:כ; מלכים א ו:ה). Ark 13
kabāru עָבֶה, עֹבִי Ark 14, 16
mūraku אֹרֶךְ As Gilg. XI 30. Ark 14, 16
imdu תְּמוֹכָה "Support, stanchion". Ark 15
kânu D כּוֹנֵן As Gilg. XI 159 [cognate]. Ark 15
rakāsu קָשַׁר סידר Literal; the boat is rope-built. Ark 17
ḫinnu תָּא קֵן Not related to qinnu / קִנִּים (Gilg. XI note 63). Ark 17, 20
elēnum u šaplum / eliš u šapliš לְמַעְלָה וּלְמַטָּה / מִלְמַעְלָה וּמִלְמַטָּה Two Akkadian pairs, two Hebrew pairs. Ark 17 / W 3′, BM 38917 rev. 6′
parāsu (allocate) הִקְצָה פרס (cognate, but "spread" in modern Hebrew) Cognate noted. Ark 18–19
kīdu, pl. kīdātu; kīdû חוּץ, חוּצוֹת; בַּחוּץ [equivalent] ↔ מִחוּץ (ו:יד). Not cognate. Ark 18, 32
qerbu קֶרֶב בַּיִת (ו:יד) [cognate]. Ark 19
šapāku שָׁפַךְ [cognate]. tabāku = יָצַק (shared §3a; Gilg. XI 66, 160 changed accordingly). Ark 20, 22
rakābu Š (uštarkib) הֶעֱמִיס הרכיב (modern "assemble") Cognate רכב noted. Ark 21, 25
kīru כִּבְשָׁן As Gilg. XI 66. Ark 21, 25, 31–32, J₁ 7′
qerēbu (ul iqribam) לֹא הִגִּיעַ (לַנִּדְרָשׁ) לא קרב (literal but opaque) Cognate קרב noted. Ark 23
nāḫu חֵלֶב שמן (= šamnu) "Lard, animal fat". Ark 24, 57
redû D הוֹסִיף Technical "add, set out in sequence" (CAD R 237a). Ark 24
mitḫāriš בְּשָׁוֶה Root of mitḫur שָׁוֶה (Gilg. XI 30). Ark 25
bīnu אֵשֶׁל Tamarisk. Ark 26
riāšu שִׂמְחָה Ark 34
kīm(tu) sallāt / kimtu, salātu מִשְׁפָּחָה וּקְרוֹבִים / מִשְׁפָּחָה, קְרוֹבִים As Gilg. XI 85. Ark 35, J r. 13′, W 8′
emūtu מְחֻתָּנִים Ark 36
ēriātu הָרוֹת Ark 37
šagāšu שָׁחַט As Gilg. XI 72. Ark 43, z v 5′–6′
ṣalālu שָׁכַב Ark 44
ūru גַּג As Gilg. XI 136. Ark 45
suppû הִתְפַּלֵּל Ark 45
gamertu / gamartu כָּלָה Atr. II (shared with C₀ iv 2′). Ark 49, C₀ iv 2′
armūtu שְׁמָמָה Ark 50
nammaštû הַנָּע רֶמֶשׂ (false echo) "What moves" (namāšu). ↔ הָרֶמֶשׂ [equivalent]. Ark 51
šanā שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם [cognate]: distributive of šina = שְׁנַיִם. Ark 52
šikaru שֵׁכָר [cognate]. (sīrāšu = סֹבֶא, shared §3a; Gilg. XI 73 changed accordingly.) Ark 53
ukullû מִסְפּוֹא Ark 56
germadû קוֹרוֹת־הַגְּלִישָׁה "Poles for the slipway" (Streck). Ark 57
pītu מִפְתָּח פֶּתַח (= bābu of the boat) pītu (from petû = פתח) "opening"; מִפְתַּח (משלי ח:ו) keeps the root without repeating פֶּתַח. Ark 60
pašīšu הַמָּשׁוּחַ הכהן המשיח (ויקרא ד:ג – echo) An anointed priest. I 6, BM 38917 obv. 16′?
māmītu שְׁבוּעָה Shared. I 10
petû (a secret) גִּלָּה As Gilg. XI 9. I 11
šanû "do again; repeat" חָזַר (עַל); שָׁנָה חזר על for repeating words (Gilg. XI 20); שָׁנִיתִי for "I did it again" [cognate]. I 13, J₁ 2′ / I₂ 14
tukultu מִבְטָח I r. 3′
bibbulu (pī bibli) הַבִּבְּלוּ (pî = פִּי) The day of the moon's disappearance; transliterated, as in Atr. II's appendix. I₂ 1

aptu חַלּוֹן Shared. ↔ חַלּוֹן הַתֵּבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה (ח:ו). I₂ 4, 10
muḫḫu (ana muḫḫi) (מֵעַל) הָרֹאשׁ מלמעלה (ו:טז) As Gilg. XI 59. I₂ 5, 10
wuššuru (a bird) שִׁלַּח As Gilg. XI 148. I₂ 5, 12, 14

pašāru פָּתַר [cognate] (Aram. פשר); the dream-interpretation verb (Wasserman). J r. 2′

kamāru D צָבַר ↔ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֵלֶיךָ (ו:כא) [equivalent]. J r. 12′
adānu מוֹעֵד As Gilg. XI 87. W 5′

urqītu / merʾītu יֶרֶק / מִרְעִית [cognate] both; ↔ יֶרֶק עֵשֶׂב (א:ל; ט:ג). W 9′, BM 38917 rev. 15′

šūtu, iltānu, šadû, amurru דָּרוֹם, צָפוֹן, מִזְרָח, מַעֲרָב The four winds; the Akkadian names in a note. U r. 6′, 9′–10′
